questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who writes books.
questions.explanation: One who writes books is an 'author'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a place where books are kept and can be borrowed.
questions.explanation: A place where books are kept for reading/borrowing is a 'library'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who flies an aeroplane.
questions.explanation: One who flies an aeroplane is a 'pilot'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a doctor who treats teeth.
questions.explanation: A doctor who treats teeth is a 'dentist'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a place where wild animals are kept for public view.
questions.explanation: Such a place is a 'zoo'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who cannot read or write.
questions.explanation: One who cannot read or write is 'illiterate'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a period of one hundred years.
questions.explanation: One hundred years is a 'century'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who sells meat.
questions.explanation: One who sells meat is a 'butcher'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who paints pictures.
questions.explanation: One who paints pictures is a 'painter'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who plays music.
questions.explanation: One who plays music is a 'musician'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a place where sick people are treated.
questions.explanation: A place where the sick are treated is a 'hospital'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who looks after the sick.
questions.explanation: One who looks after the sick is a 'nurse'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who studies the stars and planets scientifically.
questions.explanation: One who studies celestial bodies scientifically is an 'astronomer' (an astrologer predicts fortunes).

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who does not believe in the existence of God.
questions.explanation: One who denies God's existence is an 'atheist'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a form of government by the people.
questions.explanation: Government by the people is a 'democracy'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who travels on foot.
questions.explanation: One who walks/travels on foot is a 'pedestrian'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a speech delivered without previous preparation.
questions.explanation: A speech made without preparation is 'impromptu'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a place where money (coins) is manufactured.
questions.explanation: Coins are made at a 'mint'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who loves his country devotedly.
questions.explanation: One who loves his country is a 'patriot'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: animals that feed on flesh.
questions.explanation: Flesh-eating animals are 'carnivores'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who can speak many languages.
questions.explanation: One who speaks many languages is a 'polyglot' (a linguist studies language).

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a substance used to kill or stop the growth of germs.
questions.explanation: A substance that destroys germs is a 'disinfectant'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who is new to a trade or profession.
questions.explanation: A newcomer to a profession is a 'novice'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: that which cannot be believed.
questions.explanation: That which cannot be believed is 'incredible'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who studies ancient remains and antiquities.
questions.explanation: One who studies ancient remains is an 'archaeologist'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a place where dead bodies are kept for identification or post-mortem.
questions.explanation: Dead bodies are kept in a 'mortuary'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who hates women.
questions.explanation: One who hates women is a 'misogynist' (a misanthrope hates all people; a misogamist hates marriage).

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: the scientific study of birds.
questions.explanation: The study of birds is 'ornithology'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: one who is present everywhere at the same time.
questions.explanation: Present everywhere is 'omnipresent' (omnipotent = all-powerful; omniscient = all-knowing).

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a word opposite in meaning to another word.
questions.explanation: A word opposite in meaning is an 'antonym'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who talks while asleep.
questions.explanation: One who talks in sleep is a 'somniloquist' (a somnambulist walks in sleep).

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who cannot be corrected or reformed.
questions.explanation: One who cannot be corrected is 'incorrigible'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: the killing of a king.
questions.explanation: The killing of a king is 'regicide'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who collects and studies coins.
questions.explanation: A coin collector is a 'numismatist' (a philatelist collects stamps).

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a statement that seems contradictory yet may be true.
questions.explanation: A seemingly self-contradictory but possibly true statement is a 'paradox'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: the scientific study of insects.
questions.explanation: The study of insects is 'entomology' (etymology is the study of word origins).

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who walks about while asleep.
questions.explanation: One who walks in sleep is a 'somnambulist'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: an abnormal fear of enclosed or confined spaces.
questions.explanation: Fear of confined spaces is 'claustrophobia'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who remains calm and unaffected by pleasure or pain.
questions.explanation: Such a person is a 'stoic'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a supposed remedy for all diseases or troubles.
questions.explanation: A cure-all is a 'panacea'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: the killing of one's brother.
questions.explanation: Killing one's brother is 'fratricide'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who is unable to pay his debts.
questions.explanation: One unable to pay debts is 'insolvent'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: words inscribed on a tomb in memory of the dead.
questions.explanation: Words on a tomb form an 'epitaph'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who believes that the pursuit of pleasure is the chief good.
questions.explanation: Such a person is a 'hedonist'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: the custom of having more than one wife at a time.
questions.explanation: Having many wives is 'polygamy'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: that which cannot be satisfied.
questions.explanation: That which cannot be satisfied is 'insatiable'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who is indifferent or hostile to culture and the arts.
questions.explanation: One indifferent to art and culture is a 'philistine'.

questions.stem: Choose the one word for: a person who totally abstains from alcoholic drinks.
questions.explanation: One who abstains completely from alcohol is a 'teetotaller'.
